record.question: India plan to add how much of renewable energy to its electricity grid by 2030?
record.explanation: Answer B: 450 Gigawatts. At the 2019 Climate Action Summit, India stated that renewable capacity would rise beyond 175 GW and later to 450 GW. The option is 450 GW, but “add to its grid” is imprecise: 450 GW referred to the planned total capacity, not an incremental addition. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=197343. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
